acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing and using GasHunt, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Use and all applicable laws and regulations. If you do not agree with any of these terms, you are prohibited from using or accessing this site.

userAccounts.title: 2. User Accounts
userAccounts.content: You must create an account to submit fuel prices. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account and password. You agree to accept responsibility for all activities that occur under your account.

userContributions.title: 3. User Contributions
userContributions.content: When submitting fuel prices, you agree to provide accurate and current information. Intentionally submitting false information may result in account suspension or termination.

privacy.title: 4. Privacy
privacy.content: Your use of GasHunt is also governed by our Privacy Policy. Please review our Privacy Policy to understand our practices.

modifications.title: 5. Modifications
modifications.content: We reserve the right to modify or replace these Terms at any time. We will provide notice of any significant changes through our website or by sending you an email.

questions.title: Questions About Our Terms?
questions.content: If you have any questions about these Terms of Use, please contact us.

informationCollection.title: Information We Collect
informationCollection.content: We collect information that you provide directly to us, including your name, email address, and location data when you submit fuel prices. We also collect usage data and device information to improve our service.

informationUse.title: How We Use Your Information
informationUse.content: We use the information we collect to provide and improve our services, communicate with you, and ensure the security of our platform. Your location data is used to show relevant fuel prices in your area.

dataSecurity.title: Data Security
dataSecurity.content: We implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal information. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

yourRights.title: Your Rights
yourRights.content: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information. You can also opt out of certain data collection and use. Contact us to exercise these rights.

questions.title: Privacy Questions?
questions.content: If you have any questions about our privacy practices, please contact our privacy team.

learnMore.title: About GasHunt
learnMore.subtitle: Discover how we're revolutionizing the way drivers find the best fuel prices in their area.

mission.title: 🎯 Our Mission
mission.content: GasHunt was created with a simple goal: to help drivers save money on fuel through community-driven price updates. We believe that by working together, we can make fuel prices more transparent and help everyone make informed decisions about where to fill up.

howItWorks.title: ⚙️ How It Works
howItWorks.content: Users like you submit real-time fuel prices as they spot them. Our platform aggregates this data and displays it on an interactive map, making it easy to find the best prices in your area. The more people contribute, the more accurate and useful the information becomes.

realTimeUpdates.title: Real-time Updates
realTimeUpdates.content: Get the latest fuel prices as they change, updated by our community of users.

interactiveMap.title: Interactive Map
interactiveMap.content: Easily visualize and compare fuel prices in your area with our intuitive map interface.

personalDashboard.content: Dashboard that helps you track fuel stations and prices in your area

helpCenter.title: How Can We Help You? 🤔
helpCenter.subtitle: Find answers to common questions and learn how to make the most of GasHunt

submitPrice.question: How do I submit a fuel price?
submitPrice.answer: To submit a fuel price, navigate to the map, find your station, and click the 'Submit Price' button. You'll need to be logged in to submit prices.

updateFrequency.question: How often are prices updated?
updateFrequency.answer: Prices are updated in real-time as our community members submit them. Each price shows when it was last updated.

incorrectPrice.question: What if I find an incorrect price?
incorrectPrice.answer: You can thumbs down the price if it's incorrect and thumbs up the price if it's correct. This helps us keep the prices accurate.

earnPoints.question: How do I earn points?
earnPoints.answer: You earn points by submitting accurate fuel prices, verifying existing prices, and contributing to the community. More submissions = more points!

support.title: Still Need Help?
support.content: Our support team is here to help you with any questions or concerns.
